speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You presented with a chest skin lesion; to begin our assessment, have you noticed any changes in its size, shape, or color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 63-year-old male. The patient reports noticing a skin lesion on his chest 2 months ago, which he believes has increased in size. He denies any associated pain or itching with the lesion. He has a medical history significant for type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and glaucoma.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Basal Cell Carcinoma.

Based on your history of a slowly enlarging, non-painful, non-itchy lesion on your chest, I am concerned for a skin malignancy. Given your age and location of the lesion, I would like to proceed with a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy of chest lesion.
